title: Persistent issues and isolated comfort observations
summary: This topic combines unresolved problem references with a few isolated comments about cabin quietness, brightness, and stationary behavior, so the examples do not form a single coherent product issue.

positive.summary: One positive review praises how quiet the vehicle remains.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe issues that remain unresolved or require dealership follow-up.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention normal behavior, excessive brightness, the car remaining stationary, and a vague change in opinion without enough context to assign sentiment.

limitations: The fragment set is small and sentiment-stratified, so it is not representative of all reviews on this topic.
The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects rather than one clearly defined issue.
Several fragments are too short or lack context to determine the underlying feature or customer intent.
